items.name: logo-lib
items.title: Logo.dev URL Builder
items.description: Typed URL builder, retina srcset helper, and token resolution for the Logo.dev Logo Image API. Supports domain, name, ticker, crypto, and ISIN lookups.
items.author: Logo.dev <team@logo.dev>
items.docs: Get a free publishable (pk_) key at https://www.logo.dev/dashboard and set NEXT_PUBLIC_LOGO_DEV_TOKEN in .env.local.

items.name: logo
items.title: Logo
items.description: A company logo that never breaks: look up by domain, name, ticker, crypto, or ISIN with a retina srcSet, automatic dark-mode variants, and layered fallbacks (API monogram, local initials, or a custom node).
items.author: Logo.dev <team@logo.dev>
items.docs: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_LOGO_DEV_TOKEN (free key: https://www.logo.dev/dashboard). Free plans require attribution in production: https://docs.logo.dev/platform/attribution

items.name: logo-avatar
items.title: Logo Avatar
items.description: A company logo in a shadcn Avatar shell with an initials fallback — for CRM account lists, transaction feeds, and directory rows.
items.author: Logo.dev <team@logo.dev>

items.name: attribution
items.title: Logo.dev Attribution
items.description: The attribution link Logo.dev free plans require in production. Keeps the referrer intact so attribution can be verified.
items.author: Logo.dev <team@logo.dev>

items.name: logo-wall
items.title: Logo Wall
items.description: A customer or integration logo grid built from a list of domains, with grayscale-to-color hover and built-in attribution. Server-component safe.
items.author: Logo.dev <team@logo.dev>

items.name: brand-search
items.title: Brand Search
items.description: Company autocomplete backed by the Logo.dev Search API: a debounced combobox with logos per result, plus a Next.js route that keeps your secret key on the server.
items.author: Logo.dev <team@logo.dev>
items.docs: Set LOGO_DEV_SECRET_KEY (sk_) in .env.local — server-only, never expose it to the browser. Get keys at https://www.logo.dev/dashboard. Not on Next.js? Re-create the proxy from app/api/logo-dev/search/route.ts in your backend and pass `endpoint` to useBrandSearch.
